cost.convention: additional query feature fitting only; one cached native block and one same-query teacher read per layer; train-only centered FP64 ridge, validation diagnostic forward, and selected correction propagation; caller adds snapshot capture; solve and scalar diagnostic operations are analytical estimates

ridge.target: (same-actual-query Current Full history read minus reused history read)/history_count
ridge.selection: none; fixed feature mode and ridge, validation diagnostics never select or mix outputs
ridge.cached_prefix: one pass through actual corrected lower layers

joint.output_units_source: sqrt(raw-fit training baseline residual-rate MSE), floor 1e-12

cost.convention: additional refinement only; no snapshot capture or original ridge; fixed teacher read once, training objective units and scalar optimizer arithmetic estimated; frozen-backbone forward+input-backward 2x forward and trainable correction forward+backward 3x; wrapped output-unit multiplication explicitly counted

joint.objective: training-teacher-variance normalized within-user centered-logit and user-mean-logit MSE
joint.epoch_selection: minimum independent validation-user teacher objective including raw epoch0; no evaluation labels
joint.trainable_parameters: query feature affine weight and bias only; normalization and all model weights frozen
